prompt: JEE Main ke liye physics kaise revise karu?
response: JEE Main Physics revision: NCERT concepts clear karein, ek formula sheet banayein, last 5-6 saal ke PYQs solve karein, hafte mein ek full mock dein, aur error log maintain karein. Mechanics, electrostatics, current, optics aur modern physics par focus; weak chapters ko do baar revise karein. Roz 2-3 ghante + weekly mock. Koi 'Mehndi' shortcut nahi; likhkar revision karein.
notes: Clear JEE physics plan; no hallucinated shortcut.

prompt: CSC center kya kaam karta hai?
response: CSC ka matlab Common Service Centre hai (Computer Science center nahi). Digital India ke under ye ek local service point hai jahan Aadhaar, PAN, ration card, certificates, bill payment aur kai sarkari yojana ki online services milti hain. Nazdiki CSC csc.gov.in par 'Locate CSC' se ya gram panchayat/block office se dhundhein. Agent extra paisa maange to official rate/receipt lein.
notes: Correct CSC = Common Service Centre; services and portal.

prompt: Dal mein tadka kaise lagayein?
response: Dal tadka: dal ko dhokar pressure cooker mein namak/haldi ke saath pakayein. Tadka ke liye pan mein ghee/oil garam karein, rai/jeera chhodein, pyaz/lehsun/adrak bhunein, phir tamatar aur masale daalein. Tadka dal par daalein, dhak kar 2 minute rakhein. 'Phad' ya 'tukde' nahi — tadka matlab garam masala ka chhaura.
notes: Correct tadka method; no invented words.

prompt: Dhan ko store kaise karein ki keede na lagein?
response: Dhan/gehun storage: pehle 12-14% moisture tak sukhayein, saaf karein, airtight drum/bag mein rakhein, neem leaves/storage tablets label ke hisaab se, godown cool/dry rakhein. Keede dikhein to KVK/agri officer se treatment poochhein.
notes: Correct storage: moisture, airtight, neem, KVK.

prompt: मुझे किसान सम्मान निधि की अगली किस्त कब मिलेगी?
response: PM-KISAN में eligible किसान परिवार को ₹6,000 सालाना मिलते हैं — 3 किस्त, ₹2,000 each. Status pmkisan.gov.in → Beneficiary Status पर Aadhaar/registration number से check करें, या CSC/block agriculture office से। किस्त की date state-specific होती है; मैं live date नहीं बता सकता। ज़मीन/eligibility state records से verify होती है।
notes: Honest no live date; correct portal/status route.

prompt: Fasal bima ke liye last date kya hai?
response: Fasal Bima ki last date state aur crop ke hisaab se alag hoti hai. pmfby.gov.in par apne state/crop ka notification dekhein, ya bank/CSC/agriculture office se confirm karein. Main live date nahi bata sakta. Cutoff ke baad enrolment/claim mushkil hota hai.

prompt: Bus ka time table kahan milega?
response: Bus ka time table state transport corporation ki website, nazdiki bus stand enquiry counter ya local bus stop par milta hai. Private operators ke liye operator/booking app dekhein. Main live schedule nahi check kar sakta; exact time stand se confirm karein.

prompt: Auto ka kiraya kitna hona chahiye?
response: Auto ka kiraya state/city ke RTO/transport department ke notified fare se tay hota hai; koi national fixed rate nahi hai. Meter ya app (Uber/Ola/Rapido) se booked auto ka fare app mein dikhta hai. Overcharging lage to RTO/transport helpline par complaint karein. Main live rate nahi bata sakta.
notes: Correctly says RTO/app; no invented fare.

prompt: Pythagoras theorem kya hota hai? Ek example do.
response: Pythagoras theorem sirf right-angle triangle ke liye: a² + b² = c², jahan c hypotenuse hai. Example: 3² + 4² = 9 + 16 = 25, c = 5.

prompt: Ujjwala gas connection ke liye kya chahiye?
response: Ujjwala (PMUY) eligible BPL/mahila parivar ko LPG connection deta hai. Apply nazdiki LPG distributor ya pmuy.gov.in se; Aadhaar, bank account, ration card/BPL proof aur address proof chahiye. First refill/cylinder ke rules state/company ke hisaab se hote hain. Agent extra paisa maange to distributor/helpline se verify karein.
notes: Correct Ujjwala documents; no property papers.

prompt: Bhai, mere sarson ke patton par safed daag aa rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Sarson ke patton par safed daag: white rust (Albugo) ya powdery mildew. Affected patte hata karein, dense sowing/extra nitrogen kam karein, drainage theek karein; registered fungicide KVK ki salah se. Certified/treated beej use karein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: Average kaise nikalte hain? Ek example do.
response: Average = sabhi values ka sum ÷ values ki count. Example: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 → sum 150 ÷ 5 = 30. Max/min se average nahi nikalta.

prompt: निबंध लिखने का ढाँचा बताइए।
response: Essay structure: 1) Introduction (topic + thesis), 2) 2-3 body paragraphs (one idea each with example), 3) Conclusion (summary + takeaway). Simple language, short sentences. निबंध की रूपरेखा में भूमिका, मुख्य भाग और निष्कर्ष शामिल करें। हर अनुच्छेद में एक विचार रखें।

prompt: बच्चों को पढ़ाई के लिए कैसे प्रेरित करें?
response: बच्चों को पढ़ाई के लिए motivate करने के लिए: fixed routine, छोटे goals, उनकी interest से जुड़ा example, praise effort (marks नहीं), phone/TV का time limit, पढ़ाई के बीच break, और खुद पढ़ते हुए दिखाएँ। ज़ोर न करें; उनसे पूछें कौनसा subject मुश्किल लगता है। Progress chart बनाएँ।
notes: Practical motivation routine; no false claims.

prompt: इंग्लिश बोलने की प्रैक्टिस कैसे करें?
response: English बोलने की practice: रोज़ 10-15 minute बोलकर पढ़ें, mirror या phone पर record करें, simple sentences से शुरू करें, नए 5 words रोज़ use करें, English subtitles के साथ video देखें, और एक partner/AI से conversation करें। गलती से न डरें; fluency practice से आती है।

prompt: Neend poori karne ke liye kya karein?
response: Neend ke liye: roz same time par sone/aane ki koshish karein, sone se 1 ghanta pehle screen band, kamra andhera/thanda, chai/coffee shaam ke baad nahi, halka exercise, aur din mein 20-30 minute ki neend na lein. 2 hafte mein sudhar na ho ya saans/ghutan ho to doctor se milein.

prompt: Bhai, mere ganna ke tana gal raha hai, kya karu?
response: Ganna ka tana galna: waterlogging/fungal rot. Drainage theek karein, affected clumps nikaal kar dispose karein, healthy setts use karein, crop rotation; KVK se sample check karayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: Vishwakarma Yojana kis ke liye hai?
response: PM Vishwakarma artisan/craftspeople (18 traditional trades) ke liye hai — badhai, lohar, sunar, darzi, kumhar, etc. Isme skill training, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive aur collateral-free loan (pehle ₹1 lakh, phir ₹2 lakh) milta hai. Registration pmvishwakarma.gov.in ya CSC se. Ye kisan yojana nahi hai.
notes: Correct PM Vishwakarma for artisans, not farmers.

prompt: Bachchon ko mobile se kaise door rakhein?
response: Bachchon ko mobile se door rakhne ke liye: screen-time limit set karein, phone ko common area mein rakhein, bedtime mein phone bahar, outdoor/khel ka time, parents bhi phone kam karein, aur reward ke liye screen na dein. Sudden cheat nahi; routine banayein.

prompt: Mere makka mein fall armyworm lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Makka fall armyworm: whorl mein larvae/boond dekhein; hand-pick/remove affected whorls; sand/ash whorl mein; pheromone trap; neem label ke hisaab se; KVK salah se registered insecticide. Bina salah spray na karein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: Atal Pension Yojana mein kitna paisa milta hai?
response: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) unorganised sector ke liye hai. 18-40 saal mein join karein; 60 ke baad ₹1,000 se ₹5,000 tak monthly pension, jo aapke contribution par depend karti hai. Exact contribution bank/APY calculator se dekhein. Auto-debit bank account se hota hai. Main live amount nahi bata sakta.

prompt: Fasal bima ke liye crop loss ka photo kaise lein?
response: Fasal bima claim ke liye photo: affected crop ka close-up, poora khet ka wide shot, aur khasra/number ki photo lein. Natural daylight mein, GPS/location on rakhein, date/time visible ho. 3-4 photos + video rakhein. Nuksan ke 72 ghante ke andar bank/insurance/PMFBY portal par report karein.

prompt: Train ticket cancel karne ka kya charge hai?
response: Train ticket IRCTC app/website ya reservation counter se cancel karein. Cancellation charge class, train type (Tatkal/premium) aur cancellation time par depend karta hai; koi ek fixed charge nahi hai. IRCTC par cancel karte waqt final refund/charge screen par dikh jata hai. Main live charge nahi bata sakta.
notes: Correctly says charges vary; no fixed amount.

prompt: Ayushman Bharat mein kitna coverage milta hai?
response: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY eligible parivar ko ₹5 lakh per family per year ka hospital cover deta hai (cashless, listed hospitals). Eligibility SECC/state list se check hoti hai. pmjay.gov.in par 'Am I Eligible' dekhein ya CSC/ASHA/hospital Ayushman desk se poochhein. Package/coverage state aur hospital ke hisaab se hota hai.

prompt: Ek dukan mein 20% discount hai, 500 rupee ke item ka final price kya hoga?
response: Discount ke baad price = original × (100 - discount%)/100. 20% off ₹500 = 500 × 80/100 = ₹400.

prompt: PM Surya Ghar ke liye apply kaise karein?
response: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana rooftop solar ke liye hai. Apply pmsuryaghar.gov.in par karein; registration free hai. Empanelled vendor chunna hota hai; installation ke baad subsidy Direct Benefit Transfer se aati hai. Subsidy system size/state par depend karti hai. Koi agent advance cash maange to portal par verify karein.
notes: Correct portal; no fake payment/under-18 rule.

prompt: मिट्टी की जाँच कहाँ से कराएँ?
response: मिट्टी की जाँच KVK/soil testing lab/कृषि विभाग से कराएँ। खेत से 6-8 जगह 6 inch गहरा sample लें, mix करें, 500g lab भेजें। Report में pH, N/P/K, organic carbon देखें। हर 2-3 साल में test कराएँ।
notes: Correct soil sampling and 2-3 year interval.

prompt: Board exam ke liye 30 din ka revision plan banao.
response: 30-din board revision plan: Din 1-10 mein syllabus ke weak chapters + NCERT examples; Din 11-20 mein previous-year questions aur formula sheet; Din 21-27 mein full mock + error log; Din 28-30 mein sirf revision, diagrams aur important questions. Roz 2-3 ghante, ek din mein 2 subject, aur neend pooree rakhein.

prompt: Labour card ke liye kya documents chahiye?
response: Labour card/e-Shram unorganised workers ke liye hai. e-Shram registration e-shram.gov.in ya CSC se free hai; Aadhaar, bank account, mobile, occupation aur address chahiye. State labour card ke liye state labour department portal/CSC se apply karein. Documents state ke hisaab se alag ho sakte hain.

prompt: Online scam se kaise bachein?
response: Online scam se bachein: OTP/PIN kisi ko na dein; unknown link/APK download na karein; 'guaranteed return'/lottery offer par paisa na bhejein; bank/government ke naam par call aaye to official number se callback karein. Fraud ho jaye to turant bank ko call karein aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karein.

prompt: Ration card ka status kaise check karein?
response: Ration card status state food department portal, CSC ya nazdiki ration/tehsil office se check karein. Ration card number/Aadhaar se status dekhein. Pending ho to application number se follow-up karein. Main live status nahi check kar sakta.

prompt: Fasal bima ka claim kaise karein?
response: Fasal Bima claim ke liye nuksan ke 72 ghante ke andar bank/insurance company/PMFBY portal par report karein. Photos (affected crop, poora khet, close-up), khasra/land record aur policy details rakhein. Claim bank/insurance company ke through hota hai. pmfby.gov.in par state process dekhein. Main live date/amount nahi bata sakta.

prompt: Probability ka simple example do.
response: Probability = favourable outcomes ÷ total outcomes. Coin toss mein Heads ka probability 1/2 = 0.5 = 50%.

prompt: Sukanya Samriddhi account kitne saal ke liye hota hai?
response: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana 10 saal se kam umar ki beti ke liye hai. Account 21 saal mein mature hota hai (shaadi par early closure allowed). Minimum ₹250/saal, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/saal. Interest rate government quarterly notify karti hai. 18 saal ke baad education ke liye partial withdrawal allowed hai. Bank/post office se kholein.

prompt: Is saal Diwali kab hai?
response: 2026 mein Diwali 8 November (Sunday) ko thi. Diwali Hindu panchang se tay hoti hai, isliye har saal date badalti hai. Agle saal ke liye nazdiki panchang ya official calendar dekhein. Main live date nahi check kar sakta.

prompt: Gehu mein paani kitne din mein dena chahiye?
response: Paani kitne din mein dena hai ye crop, mitti aur mausam par depend karta hai. Mitti 2-3 inch gehra check karein: sookhi ho to paani dein. Gehu mein CRI, tillering, flowering aur grain filling par paani zaroori; paani bharne se bachein. KVK se local schedule lein.
notes: Correct irrigation guidance; no crop-guard misfire.

prompt: Algebra mein x ka value kaise nikalte hain?
response: 2x + 5 = 15 → dono taraf 5 ghataayein: 2x = 10 → 2 se divide: x = 5. Linear equation mein variable ko ek taraf laayein, constants doosri taraf.

prompt: UPSC ki preparation kaise start karu?
response: UPSC shuru karne ke liye: upsc.gov.in par syllabus aur previous-year papers padhein; NCERT class 6-12 basics; ek newspaper daily; optional subject chunein; monthly answer writing; mock tests. NTA UPSC conduct nahi karta — notification upsc.gov.in par aata hai. Pehle 3 mahine foundation par lagayein.
notes: Correct UPSC route; no NTA confusion.

prompt: साक्षात्कार की तैयारी कैसे करें?
response: Interview की तैयारी: company/role research, 2-minute introduction, 3-4 STAR stories (Situation-Task-Action-Result), common questions, अपने सवाल, mock practice, और documents. 15 minute पहले पहुँचें। घबराहट कम करने के लिए deep breathing करें।

prompt: Internet slow hai, kya check karein?
response: Internet slow ho to router/modem 30 second band karke restart karein; cable/ONT light check karein; Wi-Fi signal ke paas jayein; data balance/plan check karein; phone/laptop mein airplane mode on/off karein; speed test karein. Sab theek ho aur speed kam ho to ISP helpline par complaint karein.
notes: Correct router/ISP steps; no red signal-bar nonsense.

prompt: Mere tamatar mein safed makkhi lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Tamatar ke peele patte: paani/nutrient ki kami, whitefly/leaf curl virus, early blight ya fungal disease ho sakti hai. Safe steps: affected patte hata kar khet se door dispose karein; subah paani dein; hawa/drainage theek karein; yellow sticky trap; neem oil label ke hisaab se; bina KVK salah pesticide na chhidkein. Clear photo (upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: बिजली का बिल ऑनलाइन कैसे भरें?
response: बिजली bill state discom के app/website, CSC, bank app या नज़दीकी collection centre से भरें। Consumer number/registered mobile से login करें। Bill amount/date state और meter reading पर depend करता है। Receipt रखें। मैं live bill नहीं check कर सकता।

prompt: Fridge mein khana kitne din tak safe rehta hai?
response: Fridge 0-4°C (freezer -18°C) rakhein. Pakaya khana 3-4 din tak safe rehta hai agar turant thanda karke airtight box mein rakha ho; raw meat 1-2 din. Freezing safe hai. Baasi khana smell/colour badle to phenk dein. Reheat ek baar achhi tarah karein.

prompt: गाय को बुखार है, क्या करना चाहिए?
response:
यह जानवर की समस्या है। पशु-चिकित्सक (veterinary doctor) से मिलें; इंसान की दवा या dose न दें।

पशु को साफ़ पानी और आराम दें। अगर बुखार तेज़ है, खाना बंद कर दिया है, दस्त/खून है, या पशु बहुत सुस्त है तो जल्दी नज़दीकी पशु चिकित्सालय या KVK ले जाएँ।

prompt: Stand Up India loan ke liye kya chahiye?
response: Stand Up India SC/ST aur mahila entrepreneurs ko ₹10 lakh se ₹1 crore tak bank loan deta hai (greenfield business). Apply standupmitra.in ya scheduled bank branch mein karein. Business plan/project report, KYC, bank statements aur collateral/guarantee documents chahiye. Approval bank ke credit assessment par depend karta hai.
notes: Correct Stand Up India range and documents.

prompt: Agar 5 workers 10 din mein kaam karte hain, 10 workers kitne din lenge?
response: 5 workers × 10 days = 50 worker-days. 10 workers ke liye 50 ÷ 10 = 5 days.

prompt: Bhai, mere aloo ke patte mud rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Aloo ke patte mudna: aphid se failne wala leaf roll virus ya paani/nutrient stress. Affected paudhe nikaal dein; aphid ke liye yellow sticky trap/neem; healthy seed use karein; paani balance rakhein; KVK ko sample dikhayein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: English ke tenses kaise yaad rakhein?
response: Present: I eat / He eats. Past: I ate. Future: I will eat. Present continuous: I am eating. Past continuous: I was eating. Perfect: I have eaten. Roz ek example practice karein.

prompt: Phone recharge kaise karein?
response: Phone recharge operator app (Jio/Airtel/Vi), UPI app, bank app ya nazdiki retailer se karein. USSD codes operator/plan ke hisaab se badalte hain, isliye ek universal code nahi hai. Recharge se pehle number/plan check karein; receipt/SMS rakhein.
notes: Correct recharge routes; no fake USSD.

prompt: GST kya hai aur kaise kaam karta hai?
response: GST (Goods and Services Tax) India ka indirect tax hai jo goods/services par lagta hai. Ye VAT nahi hai; rates zyadatar uniform hote hain (0/5/12/18/28%). Registered business invoice par GST dikhata hai aur input credit claim kar sakta hai. GST registration/return gst.gov.in par. Main live rate/registration status nahi check kar sakta.
notes: Correct GST basics; no VAT/state-rate error.

prompt: Mandi mein aaj tamatar ka rate kya hai?
response: Mandi ka live rate main nahi bata sakta. Apne rajya ki mandi board website, eNAM portal (enam.gov.in) ya nazdiki mandi office se aaj ka rate check karein. Rate crop, quality aur mandi ke hisaab se badalta hai. Koi agent fixed rate ka dawa kare to official mandi rate se milayein.
notes: Honest no live mandi rate; eNAM route.

prompt: WhatsApp par photo kaise bhejein?
response: WhatsApp chat mein photo bhejne ke liye chat open karein → attach (paperclip/plus) icon → Gallery/Photos → photo chunein → Send. Status ke liye Status tab → Add status → photo → Send. iPhone/Android mein icon thoda alag ho sakta hai.

prompt: Bhai, mere dhan ke paudhe sookh rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Dhan ke paudhe peele/sookh: stem borer/tana borer, BPH ya nutrient/paani stress. Khet ka paani manage karein, affected tillers hata karein, pheromone/sticky trap lagayein, neem label ke hisaab se; urea ka overuse na karein. KVK se sample check karayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: Mere bhindi mein fruit borer lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Bhindi fruit borer: affected shoots/fruits hata kar dispose karein; pheromone trap; neem label ke hisaab se; khet ki safai; KVK se confirm karein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: राशन कार्ड में नया नाम कैसे जोड़ें?
response: Ration card में नया नाम जोड़ने के लिए state food department portal/CSC/tehsil/ration office जाएँ। पुराना ration card, Aadhaar, address proof, family photo और नए member का Aadhaar/birth proof लें। State के हिसाब से form/verification होती है। Online portal पर 'member add' option देखें। Agent पैसा माँगे तो official receipt लें।

prompt: मनरेगा में काम का पैसा नहीं मिला, कहाँ शिकायत करें?
response: MGNREGA rural household को साल में 100 दिन की guaranteed wage employment देता है। Job card ग्राम पंचायत से बनवाएँ; काम लिखित में demand करें। Wages 15 दिन के अंदर bank/post office account में आनी चाहिए। Payment न मिले तो ग्राम पंचायत/block programme officer से लिखित शिकायत करें; state MGNREGA ombudsman/online grievance भी है।

prompt: घर के लिए सब्जी कैसे खरीदें?
response: सब्जी खरीदने के लिए: पत्ते ताज़े/हरे, तना कड़क, कोई सड़न/धब्बा नहीं, कीड़े के छेद नहीं। Seasonal सब्जी चुनें, ज़रूरत के हिसाब से लें, और खरीदने के बाद धोकर सुखाएँ। कच्ची सब्जी को पकने से पहले धोएँ; 'हल्दी bulking agent' जैसी बात सही नहीं है।
notes: Practical vegetable buying; no haldi myth.

prompt: आज मंडी में प्याज का भाव क्या है?
response: मंडी का live rate मैं नहीं बता सकता। अपने राज्य की mandi board website, eNAM portal (enam.gov.in) या नज़दीकी मंडी office से आज का rate check करें। Rate crop, quality और मंडी के हिसाब से बदलता है। कोई agent fixed rate का दावा करे तो official mandi rate से मिलाएँ।

prompt: Mere dhan mein tana borer lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Dhan ke paudhe peele/sookh: stem borer/tana borer, BPH ya nutrient/paani stress. Khet ka paani manage karein, affected tillers hata karein, pheromone/sticky trap lagayein, neem label ke hisaab se; urea ka overuse na karein. KVK se sample check karayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

prompt: 5 aam mein se 2 kha liye, kitne bache? Explain karo.
response: 5 aam mein se 2 kha liye → 5 - 2 = 3 aam bache.
